# SQLite amalgamation

SQLite 3.46.1 (amalgamation version 3460100), public domain.

Source archive: https://www.sqlite.org/2024/sqlite-amalgamation-3460100.zip

SHA-256 of downloaded archive: `77823cb110929c2bcb0f5d48e4833b5c59a8a6e40cdea3936b99e199dbbe5784`.

Only `sqlite3.c` and `sqlite3.h` were extracted. The SQLite header includes the author's public-domain dedication. These files are compiled locally; the build does not download sources.
